title: Lanao del Sur police recover P3M smuggled cigarettes on residents’ tip

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Police recovered over P3 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes in Barangay Tacub, Pindolonan, Marantao, Lanao del Sur, following a tip from concerned residents. Authorities earlier received information from concerned citizens and local officials about the possible passage of three vehicles loaded with contraband on Saturday evening. Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, Police
